description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring five pairs of spiny arms above a long naked trunk and swollen anchored rear.
description.zh: 拟议全体生物研究：五对带刺前臂，下接裸长躯干与膨大固着后端。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level living reconstruction planning study; named fossil morphology informs the proposal, with uncertain soft anatomy kept explicit.
scientific_scope.zh: 属级活体复原规划，参考具名化石形态；软组织等不确定部分须明确标注。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is five pairs of spiny arms above a long naked trunk and swollen anchored rear; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以五对带刺前臂，下接裸长躯干与膨大固着后端为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish five pairs of spiny arms above a long naked trunk and swollen anchored rear in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以五对带刺前臂，下接裸长躯干与膨大固着后端搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: The source supports the named form; coloration, posture, soft tissues and fine proportions are not all established.
reference_notes: The era is a representative planning interval, not a full stratigraphic range or a coexistence claim. Verify the selected species, locality and specimen before a place-specific scene.

sources.title: A Tube-Dwelling Early Cambrian Lobopodian
sources.supports: Facivermis five anterior limb pairs, elongate trunk and tube-dwelling interpretation.
